name: @kairotic/cac
description: Kairotic composition assisted by computer: comes, counterpoint live — you play the dux and the comes answers, reading it at a speed (a canon, an augmentation, a crab or table canon written from both ends to the middle), with its futuribles; and the kernels every engine shares (counterpoint.mjs, mirror.mjs, soft.mjs, partimento.mjs: a given bass in two or three parts)
author: bonuoq
